digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Today moved Attorney Review into a build-ready phase and settled the Amazon Connect consent-tracking direction, while several delivery decisions and Friday deadlines still need follow-through. Tomorrow is marked out of office, so the preview keeps the remaining calendar commitments and coverage gaps visible.

items.label: Lock the Attorney Review launch date and coverage plan
items.detail: The Service Cloud build package, Legal wording, routing, permissions, training needs, and five-to-seven-minute review target were sent for configuration and testing before October 15. A new conflict remains: the Salt Lake City opening on Saturday, October 17 has 26 appointments, so decide between attorney on-call coverage that day or moving the rollout to October 19.

items.label: Clear the Amazon Connect blocker and confirm the rollout sequence
items.detail: Salesforce support ticket 474653653 is still blocking progress, although SaltClick confirmed the issue is already escalated with Salesforce. Confirm the fix, Denver's current posture, and the next office milestones; Eduardo is joining the work as additional LLF support.

items.label: Secure the final RFE MHE direction
items.detail: The sponsor decision was due today, but no final direction was found in today's available evidence. Confirm whether the project will pause, narrow its scope, or proceed under a revised plan, then communicate the impact on Legal, IT, capacity, and timing.

items.label: Set the CM-CoE backlog and Sprint 19 path
items.detail: Today's prioritization discussion surfaced continued uncertainty about which projects are consuming IT capacity. Confirm the owner, Sprint 19 placement, and follow-up date for the Phase 1 and Phase 2 requests and the pending Timetrack feedback.

items.label: Close the team self-review reminders by Friday
items.detail: HR reported that one or more team members still have not completed their year-end self-review. Contact the listed team members and confirm completion by end of day Friday, September 25.

items.label: Share the new compliance guidance with the remaining PMs
items.detail: Sara asked Jean and Jorge to distribute the guidance already sent to PMs on compliance projects to the rest of the PM team, with the right context.

items.label: Clarify the held Quality-routing deadline
items.detail: Send the interim status, revised decision point, and communication owner while the work waits for the new Phase 1 matter-plan structure.

items.label: One September Firmwide Meeting invitation was canceled
items.detail: The calendar explicitly marked one 2:00 PM invitation as canceled, while a separate active invitation remained at the same time.

items.label: Amazon Connect consent tracking will be enabled
items.detail: Nadia approved adding the predefined consent attribute and Connect dashboard reporting proposed for tracking and audit purposes.

items.label: Jean and Nadia are marked out of office Friday
items.detail: Jean's calendar is marked out of office for the day, and Nadia is also on PTO. Set coverage for any time-sensitive Amazon Connect or Attorney Review follow-up.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect daily standup remains active
items.detail: The separate Salesforce Program Standup is canceled, but the Amazon Connect standup remains on the calendar.

items.label: 2:30 PM - Project pipeline weekly sync
items.detail: The agenda covers new intake prioritization, BA assignment, active-project changes, and UAT status for the coming sprint.

items.label: 3:00 PM - Sprint review overlaps the executive status update
items.detail: The IT Litify Sprint 18 stakeholder review and the Executive Project Status Slide Update are scheduled for the same half hour, so coverage or delegation is needed.
